text:
Sam: Quick sync  prospect (regulated healthcare) requested an on-prem POC in a locked facility. They asked: couriered USB vs pull from a vetted jumpbox, upgrade cadence, SBOM provenance, and uplift to the quote. Need short answers by EOD.

Ivy: They prefer couriered media for initial seed. Followups: can we provide encrypted USB + signed manifest?

Diego: Yes. We ship encrypted USB with signed manifest and checksum. Full image ~11GB compressed; security minibundles ~<200MB. For tiny-transfer sites we split into 500MB parts.

Marta: Cadence: recommend monthly security minibundles, quarterly feature rollups. Emergency hotfix path (48-72h) available as paid add-on.

Sam: What about SBOM and key provenance wording for their security questionnaire?

LegalBot: Proposed: "We provide a redacted SBOM and signer certificate chain. Signing is performed in FIPS 140-2/3 HSMs; private key material never leaves the HSM. HSM attestation and redacted audit logs available under NDA."

Ivy: Ops/verification snippet to share with compliance:
```
# verify chunks, signature, then reassemble
sha256sum part_* > parts.sha256
redwood-verify --manifest parts.sha256 --cert signer.crt
cat part_* > image.tar.gz && tar -tzf image.tar.gz
```

Diego: Licensing note: offline installs require activation tokens they import via CLI. We include token-generator and offline activation steps in the runbook.

Marta: Commercials: one-time packaging fee + PS for chunking/testing (estimate 8-14h) + 1.15x concierge uplift for first quarter. Emergency channel as monthly premium.

Sam: Plan: Marta to add lines to quote; LegalBot to finalize wording; Diego/Ivy to produce runbook + sample SBOM (redacted) and chunker tool. I'll send consolidated reply by tomorrow morning. Any blockers?

Ivy: Compliance wants the redacted SBOM first; Diego will upload and share link.

PackagerBot: Reminder: do not include private key material in uploads; share only cert chain and redacted logs.

Sam: Thanks all. :thumbsup:
